purpose: Close v7r2 missing exact Docker-build evidence and external Owner-trigger proof without weakening Lab/Auditor/Owner gates.

docker_build_evidence.trigger: push on authoritative candidate branch; no workflow_dispatch
docker_build_evidence.checkout: exact GITHUB_SHA fetched directly without third-party checkout action

flow: After future Independent Lab PASS, Independent Auditor PASS, Owner Presentation and exact Owner approval, Core writes an external Owner Approval Receipt to PR #74.
Owner creates exactly one fresh dedicated Codespace from the frozen candidate only after that approval.

Root image ENTRYPOINT starts the reviewed external session gate automatically and generates a fresh 128-bit nonsecret per-container challenge, reports CODESPACE_NAME, challenge and local image-identity SHA-256, then waits fail-closed.
Owner reports only those nonsecret session identifiers to Core; no token, secret, capability fd, OAuth device code or security payload is copied.
Core Fresh Reads authority/binding and writes one session-binding receipt to PR #74 through the external ChatGPT GitHub connector.

Session gate accepts exactly one receipt authored as repository owner fufufu1116 and performed_via_github_app.slug=chatgpt-codex-connector, bound to exact codespace name, fresh challenge, candidate head/tree, image-identity SHA-256, one-shot Owner Approval Receipt and Runtime OFF.
The challenge changes on every container start, so an old session receipt cannot authorize a restarted/rebuilt container; a different Codespace name cannot replay the receipt.
Only after external receipt verification does the root gate same-object execute the root producer; otherwise it exits 92.
external_owner_trigger.owner_burden: one fresh Codespace creation plus one nonsecret session-identifier acknowledgement; no authoritative startup payload paste
